# `wait`

> Profile: deferred · Permission key: `[permission] wait`

Block until something you are waiting for happens instead of polling `bg` every step: a background job finishes (its id, exit status and output tail come back), a message from the user arrives (reported as pending; end the step to read it), or `timeout_secs` elapses. Returns at once when no job is running.

Deferred tools are not advertised on every request. Activate one with `tool_search` or set `session.tool_profile = "full"`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `job_id` | string | no | Only wait for this background job (e.g. bg-1); default: any job |
| `timeout_secs` | integer | no | Seconds to wait before giving up (default 60, max 300) |
